notes: Fixes the concrete ImportError reported by the container: diffusers.pipelines.pipeline_utils imports CachedRepoTreeNotFoundError from huggingface_hub.errors, which the installed huggingface_hub does not export. The shim now defines that exception class (as an Exception subclass) and injects it into huggingface_hub.errors, huggingface_hub, huggingface_hub.hf_api and huggingface_hub._snapshot_download before diffusers is imported, in addition to the existing get_cached_repo_tree shim. cmd_run also passes through the shim again on a targeted ImportError/RuntimeError. docotor additionally reports CachedRepoTreeNotFoundError availability. All shims are no-ops when the symbol already exists, so a newer huggingface_hub is not overridden. Benchmark contract is unchanged: CUDA fp16 real inpainting, 512x512, 12 steps, guidance 7.5, mask composite preserving black regions pixel-for-pixel, index.jsonl, run.json, config.json, hashes, synchronized timings, seed replay. No execution is claimed by the solver.
